relationships.subject: NGF
relationships.evidence_quote: It was reported that the expression of Nav1.7 in DRG could be induced by nerve growth factor (NGF)

relationships.subject: GNE-0439
relationships.evidence_quote: GNE-0439 also attenuated mechanical pain in SCI mice significantly at a dose range from 10 to 30 μg/kg

relationships.subject: PF-05089771
relationships.evidence_quote: Intraperitoneal injection of 2 mg/kg PF-05089771 significantly alleviated mechanical pain when compared to vehicle (Figure 4A)

relationships.subject: spinal cord injury
relationships.evidence_quote: The results showed that Nav1.7 was significantly upregulated 1.5-fold in DRG of SCI mice when compared to that in naive mice

key_findings: SCI induces ectopic Nav1.7 expression in spinal dorsal horn neurons and upregulation in DRG, associated with NGF/JUN increase
BBB-permeable Nav1.7 blocker GNE-0439 relieved mechanical pain better than BBB-impermeable PF-05089771
